description: DynamoDB data plan events must be captured by CloudTrail logging

requirements.description: A DynamoDB table is defined and no CloudTrail trail in the template configures data event logging for any DynamoDB resource.
requirements.rationale: If no trail captures DynamoDB data plane events, the assessed table's item-level activity is unaudited. AWS docs note trails do not log data events by default; explicit configuration is required.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail exists but is configured to log data events only for non-DynamoDB resource types (for example object storage or function invocations).
requirements.rationale: Data event logging is resource-type specific. A trail logging only S3 object or Lambda function events does not capture DynamoDB data plane operations on the assessed table.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail captures DynamoDB data events covering the assessed table, but the trail's logging state is explicitly disabled.
requirements.rationale: A trail that is not actively logging will not deliver any events, including DynamoDB data events, regardless of its event selector configuration.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail enumerates DynamoDB tables for data event logging by specific identifier, and the assessed table's identifier is not among them while other tables are.
requirements.rationale: Coverage is per-resource. When tables are listed individually, only the listed tables have their data events logged; the assessed table is unaudited.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail is configured to log data events for all DynamoDB tables but explicitly excludes the assessed table by selector condition.
requirements.rationale: An advanced selector that filters out the assessed table's identifier removes it from coverage even though other DynamoDB tables remain covered.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail is present but whether its data event configuration includes DynamoDB tables (or which tables are referenced) depends on a value that cannot be resolved at analysis time.
requirements.rationale: When coverage cannot be conclusively determined, the rule cannot assert non-compliance. Per the resolved decision on lenient pattern matching, undeterminable matches are assumed to provide coverage.

requirements.description: Two CloudTrail trails are defined: one logs DynamoDB data events covering the assessed table, while another logs only management events or unrelated data event types.
requirements.rationale: Coverage by any single trail is sufficient. The presence of additional trails that do not cover DynamoDB does not invalidate the covering trail.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail declares an event selector for DynamoDB data events but the list of covered table identifiers is empty.
requirements.rationale: An empty resource list provides no coverage for any specific table, including the assessed one.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail logs data events for all DynamoDB tables using a wildcard or all-tables selector that matches every table in the account.
requirements.rationale: An all-DynamoDB-tables selector (for example, an ARN prefix matching all tables) captures data events for the assessed table. AWS docs describe this as the all-resources logging mode.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail enumerates DynamoDB tables for data event logging by specific identifier and the assessed table's identifier appears in the list.
requirements.rationale: Direct enumeration of the assessed table's identifier in the trail's data resource list provides explicit coverage of its data plane events.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail covers the assessed DynamoDB table for data events but is scoped to read-only events only or write-only events only.
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision: any data event coverage (read-only or write-only) is considered sufficient to satisfy the rule.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail with matching DynamoDB data event coverage is single-region and the assessed table's region differs or is not determinable from the template.
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision: region matching is out of scope. Any trail with matching data event selectors satisfies the rule regardless of region.

requirements.description: A CloudTrail trail's data event configuration references DynamoDB tables via an ARN pattern or wildcard whose match against the assessed table cannot be conclusively determined.
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision: when a pattern-based match is inconclusive, the rule assumes the pattern covers the table (lenient interpretation).
